name: Substitution into formulae
subject: Mathematical Literacy
example_problem: Using cost = R450 + R12,50 x km, calculate the cost of a 340 km trip; then find how many kilometres R1 200 buys.

importance.summary: Measurement is Question 3 on every Paper 2, and tariff/cost formulas in Finance (Q2, Paper 1) are substitution work - it earns marks on both papers every year.
